task: Say how website visits changed. Website visits: March 40,000 → April 42,000.
say: How did the website do in April?
zh: 说说网站访问量的变化。网站访问量：3月 40,000 → 4月 42,000。对方说：网站 4月表现怎么样？
example: Website visits went up by 5 per cent in April, from 40,000 to 42,000.

task: Say how sales changed this quarter. Quarterly sales: Q1 $500,000 → Q2 $470,000.
zh: 说说本季度销售额的变化。季度销售额：第一季度 $500,000 → 第二季度 $470,000。
example: Sales dropped by 6 per cent this quarter, from $500,000 in Q1 to $470,000 in Q2.

task: Say how sign-ups changed month on month. Monthly sign-ups: March 4,200 → April 4,410.
zh: 用“环比”的说法说说注册数的变化。月注册数：3月 4,200 → 4月 4,410。
example: Sign-ups rose 5 per cent month on month, from 4,200 in March to 4,410 in April.

task: Give the year-on-year change in revenue. October revenue: last year $1.20 million → this year $1.32 million.
zh: 说出收入的同比变化。10月收入：去年 $1.20M → 今年 $1.32M。对方说：10月收入怎么样？
example: October revenue was 1.32 million dollars, up 10 per cent year on year.

words.en: up 10 per cent on last October

task: Give the quarter-on-quarter change in support tickets. Support tickets: Q2 2,400 → Q3 2,160.
zh: 说出支持工单数量的季度环比变化。工单数：第二季度 2,400 → 第三季度 2,160。
example: Support tickets fell 10 per cent quarter on quarter, from 2,400 in Q2 to 2,160 in Q3.

words.en: a step in the right direction

task: Report the change in customer churn. Be careful: percent change vs percentage points. Monthly churn rate: 4% → 3%.
zh: 汇报客户流失率的变化。注意区分“百分比变化”和“百分点”。月流失率：4% → 3%。
example: Our churn rate dropped from 4 per cent to 3 per cent. That's a fall of one percentage point, or a quarter fewer customers leaving.

task: Report the change in the conversion rate, in percentage points and in relative terms. Website conversion rate: 2.5% → 3.0%.
zh: 汇报转化率的变化，分别用百分点和相对变化来说。网站转化率：2.5% → 3.0%。
example: Conversion went up half a percentage point, from 2.5 to 3 per cent. In relative terms, that's a 20 per cent improvement.

task: Say how much of the yearly budget has been used so far. Project hours used year to date (January–October): 8,600. Annual budget: 10,000 hours.
zh: 说说今年到目前为止用了多少年度预算。项目工时年初至今（1–10月）：8,600 小时。全年预算：10,000 小时。
example: Year to date, we've used 8,600 hours, which is 86 per cent of our 10,000-hour budget for the year.

task: Say how daily active users changed over the year. Daily active users: November last year 15,000 → now 30,000.
zh: 说说一年来日活跃用户的变化。日活跃用户：去年11月 15,000 → 现在 30,000。
example: Our daily active users doubled over the past year, from 15,000 to 30,000.

task: Say what happened to page load time after the fix. Average page load time: before the fix 4.2 seconds → after 2.1 seconds.
zh: 说说修复之后页面加载时间的变化。平均页面加载时间：修复前 4.2 秒 → 修复后 2.1 秒。
example: After the fix, average page load time halved, from 4.2 seconds to 2.1.

task: Say what share of orders came from mobile, using a simple fraction. Orders last month: 10,000 in total, 3,350 from mobile.
zh: 用一个简单的分数说说手机端订单的占比。上月订单：共 10,000 单，其中手机端 3,350 单。
example: Roughly a third of all orders last month came from mobile, 3,350 out of 10,000.

task: Report uptime against the target, using "just under". Server uptime last month: 99.87%. Target: 99.9%.
zh: 用 "just under" 汇报正常运行时间与目标的对比。上月服务器正常运行时间：99.87%。目标：99.9%。
example: Uptime last month was 99.87 per cent, just under our target of 99.9.

words.en: a fraction of a per cent

task: Report the survey response count against the goal, using "just over". Survey responses: 1,020. Goal: 1,000.
say: Did we get enough survey responses?
zh: 用 "just over" 汇报问卷回收数量与目标的对比。问卷回复数：1,020。目标：1,000。对方说：问卷回收得够吗？
example: Yes, we got just over a thousand, 1,020 in total, so we hit our goal.

task: Say that electricity use did not really change. Office electricity use: January 52,000 kWh → February 52,100 kWh.
zh: 说说用电量基本没变。办公室用电量：1月 52,000 千瓦时 → 2月 52,100 千瓦时。
example: Electricity use stayed flat in February, at around 52,000 kilowatt hours.

task: Say when website traffic reached its highest point. Daily visits peaked at 18,500 on 28 November (Black Friday).
zh: 说说网站流量什么时候达到峰值。日访问量在 11月28日（黑色星期五）达到峰值 18,500。
example: Traffic peaked at 18,500 visits on the 28th of November, which was Black Friday.

task: Say when fleet utilisation was at its lowest. Rental fleet utilisation: lowest in July at 61%. July is usually the quietest month.
zh: 说说车队利用率什么时候最低。租赁车队利用率：7月最低，为 61%。7月通常是最淡的月份。
example: Fleet utilisation hit a low of 61 per cent in July, which is usually our quietest month.

task: Report the average time to resolve a support ticket. Average resolution time last month: 6.4 hours.
say: How quickly are we closing tickets?
zh: 汇报解决一张支持工单的平均用时。上月平均解决时间：6.4 小时。对方说：我们关闭工单的速度怎么样？
example: On average, it took us 6.4 hours to resolve a ticket last month.

words.en: just under six and a half hours

task: Compare the average and the median order value, and say what the difference means. Average order value: $86. Median order value: $54.
zh: 比较订单金额的平均数和中位数，并说说这个差别意味着什么。平均订单金额：$86。订单金额中位数：$54。
example: The average order value was $86, but the median was only $54. So a small number of big orders are pulling the average up.

task: Report new customers against the target. New customers in Q3: 270. Target: 300.
say: Did we hit the Q3 target for new customers?
zh: 汇报新客户数与目标的对比。第三季度新客户：270。目标：300。对方说：第三季度新客户目标达成了吗？
example: Not quite. We signed 270 new customers, which is 30 short of our target of 300. So we got to 90 per cent of target.

words.zh: 很接近，但还是差了一点

task: Report cloud costs against the budget, in dollars and as a percentage. Cloud costs in September: $46,000. Budget: $40,000.
zh: 用金额和百分比汇报云成本与预算的对比。9月云成本：$46,000。预算：$40,000。
example: Cloud costs came in at $46,000 in September. That's $6,000, or 15 per cent, over budget.

task: Say which region ranked second. Sales by region this year: Auckland $2.1M, Canterbury $1.4M, Wellington $1.2M.
zh: 说说哪个地区排第二。今年各地区销售额：奥克兰 $2.1M，坎特伯雷 $1.4M，惠灵顿 $1.2M。
example: Canterbury was our second-largest region this year, with 1.4 million dollars in sales, behind Auckland at 2.1 million.

task: Say what share of total revenue came from enterprise customers. Total revenue: $8M. Enterprise customers: $3.2M.
zh: 说说企业客户占总收入的比例。总收入：$8M。企业客户：$3.2M。
example: Enterprise customers accounted for 40 per cent of total revenue. That's 3.2 million out of 8 million.

task: Say how the number of open bugs changed. Open bugs: start of sprint 120 → end of sprint 85.
zh: 说说未解决 bug 数量的变化。未解决 bug：冲刺开始时 120 → 冲刺结束时 85。
example: The number of open bugs fell from 120 at the start of the sprint to 85 at the end.

words.en: by the end of the sprint

task: Report the year-on-year change in store foot traffic. Store visitors in September: last year 50,000 → this year 46,000.
say: How's foot traffic looking compared with last year?
zh: 汇报门店客流量的同比变化。9月门店访客：去年 50,000 → 今年 46,000。对方说：跟去年比，客流量怎么样？
example: It's down, unfortunately. We had 46,000 visitors in September, down 8 per cent year on year from 50,000.

task: Say how newsletter subscribers changed. Newsletter subscribers: May 2,000 → November 6,000.
zh: 说说邮件订阅人数的变化。订阅人数：5月 2,000 → 11月 6,000。
example: Newsletter subscribers have tripled in six months, from 2,000 in May to 6,000 now.

task: Report the change in Net Promoter Score. NPS is a score, so say "points", not "per cent". NPS: Q2 32 → Q3 41.
zh: 汇报净推荐值（NPS）的变化。NPS 是一个分数，所以要说 "points"，不要说 "per cent"。NPS：第二季度 32 → 第三季度 41。
example: Our NPS went up nine points this quarter, from 32 to 41.

words.en: it's a score, not a percentage

task: Report the change in the email open rate, in percentage points. Email open rate: August 22% → September 19%.
zh: 用百分点汇报邮件打开率的变化。邮件打开率：8月 22% → 9月 19%。
example: Our email open rate dropped three percentage points in September, from 22 to 19 per cent.

words.en: a relative fall of 14 per cent

task: Report the change in market share, in percentage points and in relative terms. Market share: last year 18% → this year 21%.
zh: 用百分点和相对变化汇报市场份额的变化。市场份额：去年 18% → 今年 21%。
example: Our market share grew from 18 to 21 per cent. That's up three percentage points, or about 17 per cent in relative terms.

words.en: about 17 per cent in relative terms

task: Say how customer satisfaction changed. Average satisfaction score (out of 5): Q2 4.1 → Q3 4.2.
zh: 说说客户满意度的变化。平均满意度（满分 5 分）：第二季度 4.1 → 第三季度 4.2。
example: Customer satisfaction rose slightly, from 4.1 to 4.2 out of 5.

task: Report the change in the cost per click for online ads. Cost per click: August $1.80 → September $1.53.
zh: 汇报在线广告单次点击成本的变化。单次点击成本：8月 $1.80 → 9月 $1.53。
example: Our cost per click came down 15 per cent in September, from $1.80 to $1.53.

task: Report the month-on-month change in app crashes. App crashes: September 1,250 → October 1,000.
zh: 汇报应用崩溃次数的环比变化。崩溃次数：9月 1,250 → 10月 1,000。
example: App crashes fell 20 per cent month on month, from 1,250 in September to 1,000 in October.

task: Compare year-to-date revenue with the same period last year. Revenue January–September: this year $9.6M, last year $8.0M.
say: Are we ahead of last year?
zh: 把今年到目前为止的收入和去年同期比较。1–9月收入：今年 $9.6M，去年 $8.0M。对方说：我们比去年同期好吗？
example: Yes, comfortably. Year to date, revenue is 9.6 million, which is 20 per cent ahead of the same period last year.

task: Say where rent ranks among our costs. Share of total spending: staff 55%, cloud 20%, office rent 15%, other 10%.
zh: 说说房租在各项成本中排第几。占总支出比例：人员 55%，云服务 20%，办公室租金 15%，其他 10%。
example: Office rent is our third-largest cost, at 15 per cent of total spending, after staff and cloud.

task: Say what share of support tickets were password resets. Tickets last month: 2,000 in total, 700 password resets.
zh: 说说密码重置工单占所有工单的比例。上月工单：共 2,000 张，其中密码重置 700 张。
example: Password resets accounted for 35 per cent of all tickets last month. That's 700 out of 2,000.

words.en: a big chunk of the workload

words.zh: 容易摘的果子（易解决的问题）

task: Compare revenue growth with profit growth and say what it means for margins. Year on year: revenue +12%, profit +3%.
zh: 比较收入增长和利润增长，并说说这对利润率意味着什么。同比：收入 +12%，利润 +3%。
example: Revenue grew 12 per cent year on year, but profit only grew 3 per cent. So our margins are getting squeezed.

task: Say how app downloads changed, using "nearly". App downloads: Q1 5,100 → Q2 9,800.
zh: 用 "nearly" 说说应用下载量的变化。下载量：第一季度 5,100 → 第二季度 9,800。
example: App downloads nearly doubled quarter on quarter, from 5,100 to 9,800.

task: Report the change in the defect rate, in percentage points and in relative terms. Defect rate: 1.2% → 0.8%.
zh: 用百分点和相对变化汇报缺陷率的变化。缺陷率：1.2% → 0.8%。
example: The defect rate fell from 1.2 to 0.8 per cent. That's down 0.4 of a percentage point, so a third fewer defects.

task: Say how daily visits dropped and then recovered. Daily visits: normal 12,000 → outage day 7,500 → now 12,200.
zh: 说说日访问量先下降、后恢复的情况。日访问量：平时 12,000 → 故障当天 7,500 → 现在 12,200。
example: Daily visits dropped to 7,500 on the day of the outage, but they've bounced back to 12,200, slightly above the 12,000 we had before.

task: Give the range and the median of API response times. Response times yesterday: fastest 120 ms, slowest 950 ms, median 210 ms.
zh: 说出 API 响应时间的范围和中位数。昨天响应时间：最快 120 毫秒，最慢 950 毫秒，中位数 210 毫秒。
example: Yesterday's response times ranged from 120 to 950 milliseconds, with a median of 210.

task: Report the change in tickets handled per agent, with a rough percentage. Tickets per agent per week: 48 → 56.
zh: 汇报每位客服处理工单数的变化，给出一个大概的百分比。每人每周工单数：48 → 56。
example: Each agent is now handling 56 tickets a week, up from 48. That's an increase of about 17 per cent.

task: Say that staff turnover has not changed. Annual staff turnover: 12% in each of the last three years.
zh: 说说员工流失率一直没变。年度员工流失率：过去三年每年都是 12%。
example: Staff turnover has held steady at 12 per cent for the last three years.

task: Say that August set a new record. Monthly revenue: August $780,000 (record). Previous record: March $740,000.
zh: 说说8月创下了新纪录。月收入：8月 $780,000（创纪录）。之前的纪录：3月 $740,000。
example: August was a record month. Revenue hit $780,000, beating our previous high of $740,000 back in March.

words.zh: 有史以来最好的一个月
打破了之前的最高纪录

task: Say how many users use two-factor authentication, as "one in ...". Users: 10,000 in total, 2,500 with two-factor authentication on.
zh: 用 "one in ..." 的说法说说有多少用户开启了双重验证。用户：共 10,000 人，其中 2,500 人开启了双重验证。
example: Only one in four users, 2,500 out of 10,000, have turned on two-factor authentication.

task: Report the survey result in a natural way, not just the percentage. Staff survey: 62% prefer hybrid working.
zh: 自然地汇报调查结果，不要只念百分比。员工调查：62% 的人更喜欢混合办公。
example: Just over six in ten people, 62 per cent, said they'd prefer hybrid working.

task: Give both the month-on-month and the year-on-year change in sales. Sales: September $200,000 → October $220,000. October last year: $250,000.
say: So October was a good month?
zh: 同时说出销售额的环比和同比变化。销售额：9月 $200,000 → 10月 $220,000。去年10月：$250,000。对方说：所以 10月表现不错？
example: Partly. October sales were $220,000. That's up 10 per cent on September, but still down 12 per cent year on year.

words.en: it depends how you look at it
not out of the woods yet

task: Report consultant utilisation against the target, in percentage points. Average consultant utilisation: 78%. Target: 85%.
zh: 用百分点汇报顾问利用率与目标的对比。顾问平均利用率：78%。目标：85%。
example: Consultant utilisation averaged 78 per cent, which is seven percentage points below our 85 per cent target.

task: Describe a sudden jump in login errors. Login errors: normally about 30 a day → Tuesday 450.
zh: 描述登录错误的突然激增。登录错误：平时每天约 30 次 → 周二 450 次。
example: Login errors spiked on Tuesday, from about 30 a day to 450. That's fifteen times the normal level.

task: Say the engagement score went down a little. Staff engagement score (out of 10): last year 7.8 → this year 7.5.
zh: 说说员工敬业度分数略有下降。敬业度分数（满分 10 分）：去年 7.8 → 今年 7.5。
example: Our engagement score dipped slightly this year, from 7.8 to 7.5 out of 10.

task: Describe a very large increase in API calls after a partner launch. API calls per day: before 50,000 → after 500,000.
zh: 描述合作伙伴上线之后 API 调用量的大幅增长。每日 API 调用：之前 50,000 → 之后 500,000。
example: API calls went up tenfold after the partner launch, from 50,000 to half a million a day.

task: Describe a steady decline and give the overall change. Monthly active users: July 24,000, August 23,100, September 22,300.
zh: 描述持续下降，并说出总体变化。月活跃用户：7月 24,000，8月 23,100，9月 22,300。
example: Active users have dropped every month since July, from 24,000 to 22,300 in September. That's down about 7 per cent overall.

task: Report the change in cost per transaction, in cents and as a percentage. Cost per transaction: 42 cents → 35 cents.
zh: 用分和百分比汇报每笔交易成本的变化。每笔交易成本：42 分 → 35 分。
example: Cost per transaction came down from 42 cents to 35. That's a saving of seven cents, or about 17 per cent.

task: Say when storage will run out at the current rate. Storage used: 80 TB of 100 TB. Growth: about 4 TB per month. It is now November.
say: How long until we run out of storage?
zh: 说说按目前速度存储空间什么时候会用完。已用存储：100 TB 中的 80 TB。增长：每月约 4 TB。现在是11月。对方说：还有多久存储空间会用完？
example: We're using 80 of our 100 terabytes, and growing by about 4 a month. So at this rate, we'll be full in about five months, around April.

task: Compare how fast customers pay us with the industry average. Average days to get paid: us 38 days, industry average 45 days.
zh: 比较我们的回款速度和行业平均水平。平均回款天数：我们 38 天，行业平均 45 天。
example: On average, customers pay us in 38 days. That's a week faster than the industry average of 45.

task: Report the Wellington office's energy saving and its new ranking. Wellington office: energy use −14%, moved from 3rd to 1st place among our four offices.
zh: 汇报惠灵顿办公室的节能成果和排名变化。惠灵顿办公室：用电量 −14%，在四个办公室中从第3名升到第1名。
example: The Wellington office cut its energy use by 14 per cent, and moved from third to first place out of our four offices.

task: Give the highest and the lowest scores in the staff survey. Highest: "team support" 8.6/10. Lowest: "workload" 5.9/10.
zh: 说出员工调查中得分最高和最低的项目。最高：“团队支持” 8.6/10。最低：“工作量” 5.9/10。
example: The highest-scoring question was team support, at 8.6, and the lowest was workload, at 5.9 out of 10.

task: Say what share of staff finished the training, using a fraction. Security training: 450 of 600 staff completed.
zh: 用分数说说完成培训的员工比例。安全培训：600 名员工中 450 人已完成。对方说：安全培训进展如何？
example: Pretty well. Three-quarters of staff, 450 out of 600, have completed it so far.

task: Compare mobile and desktop growth and say where most of the growth came from. Monthly visits, last year → this year: desktop 100,000 → 102,000; mobile 50,000 → 59,000.
zh: 比较手机端和电脑端的增长，并说说增长主要来自哪里。月访问量，去年 → 今年：电脑端 100,000 → 102,000；手机端 50,000 → 59,000。
example: Mobile visits grew 18 per cent year on year, while desktop only grew 2 per cent. So most of our growth, about 80 per cent of it, came from mobile.

task: Say how manual deployments changed after automation. Manual deployments per month: before 40 → after 10.
zh: 说说自动化之后手动部署次数的变化。每月手动部署：之前 40 次 → 之后 10 次。
example: Since we automated the pipeline, manual deployments are down 75 per cent, from 40 a month to just 10.

words.en: a quarter of what it was

task: Report the change in gross margin clearly, giving both the percentage-point change and the relative change. Gross margin: last year 30% → this year 27%.
zh: 清楚地汇报毛利率的变化，同时给出百分点变化和相对变化。毛利率：去年 30% → 今年 27%。
example: Gross margin fell from 30 to 27 per cent. To be clear, that's a drop of three percentage points, which is a 10 per cent fall in relative terms.

words.en: it's easy to mix these up

task: Explain why a 20% fall followed by a 20% rise does not bring the price back. Licence price per user: $100 → $80 (−20%) → $96 (+20%).
say: So the licence price is back where it started?
zh: 解释为什么先降 20% 再涨 20% 并没有回到原价。每用户许可证价格：$100 → $80（−20%）→ $96（+20%）。对方说：所以许可证价格回到原来的水平了？
example: Not quite. It fell 20 per cent to $80, then rose 20 per cent to $96. Because the second 20 per cent is on a smaller number, we're still 4 per cent below where we started.
